company.description:
Udenz is a digital health and dental technology platform that connects patients, dentists, clinics, and dental professionals through an integrated online ecosystem. Founded in 2015 by Hisham Safadi, the company aims to simplify access to dental care and improve collaboration within the dental industry, particularly in the Middle East and North Africa (MENA) region.

The platform provides a range of digital tools and services that help both patients and dental professionals. Patients can search for nearby dentists, read information about dental treatments, and book appointments online, while dental clinics can manage services such as electronic dental records, online consultations, and patient management through the platform.
